meta.description:
"Brother, are we really taking a bath together?"



And so, a forbidden bathing experience began. Me, my sister, and childhood friend—one man and two women—are sharing one bath. After involuntarily "overflowing," the sister's secret love comes out?!

Studio: Studio Houkiboshi
